title: Cancel Hidden Roku and Streaming Add-Ons
hook_text: GHOST STREAMING SUBSCRIPTIONS DRAIN YOUR WALLET

beats.say: You're likely paying for ghost streaming add-ons you haven't opened in months.
beats.visual: Cinematic low-angle shot of a dark living room with a glowing TV screen reflecting on a wooden coffee table.

beats.say: Most people don't realize single-click add-ons bypass their main app receipts.
beats.visual: Close-up of a hand holding a black streaming remote in a dimly lit room.

beats.say: How do these hidden charges quietly drain your bank account every month?
beats.visual: Macro shot of a credit card resting on a dark glass surface with moody window light.

beats.say: You'd assume they show up on your credit card as clear monthly bills.
beats.visual: A pile of unopened paper bills sitting on a dark oak desk under a single desk lamp.

beats.say: They actually get bundled into your device account, hidden behind one generic line item.
beats.visual: A close-up of a thumb pressing a button on a dark remote control.

beats.say: Where does that extra money actually go while you're not watching?
beats.visual: A slow pan across an empty, modern apartment lit by dusk streetlights outside.

beats.say: Step one. Grab your remote and open your Roku account settings on the TV.
beats.visual: A person pointing a remote at a blank television screen in a moody room.

beats.say: Step two. Highlight any app, press the Star button on your remote, and click Manage Subscription.
beats.visual: Close-up of fingers pressing a star button on a dark remote control.

beats.say: Step three. Cancel every channel you haven't actively watched in the last thirty days.
beats.visual: A hand tapping a minimalist digital toggle switch on a dark screen.

beats.say: A fifteen dollar monthly subscription for ten years wastes one thousand eight hundred dollars.
beats.visual: A neat stack of polymer currency bills sitting on a dark concrete tabletop.

beats.say: Stop letting forgotten video add-ons quietly rob your future savings.
beats.visual: A wide shot of a solitary chair by a large window looking out at a rainy city.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: A dark hallway with a warm, single light source glowing at the far end.

caption: Stop paying for apps you forgot existed. Here is how to kill hidden streaming add-ons today. #personalfinance #moneytips #budgeting #savingmoney #quietmoney
description: Eliminate overlooked video service add-ons billed through streaming devices in under 15 minutes. Take control of your recurring expenses today.
first_comment: Which forgotten subscription did you finally cancel today?
